description: This file is a C++ header defining functions for symbolizing program counters into human-readable function names within the Abseil library, specifically for debugging purposes.

methods.name: InitializeSymbolizer
methods.description: Initializes the symbolizer with the program path, enabling symbolization of program counters.

methods.name: Symbolize
methods.description: Converts a program counter to a human-readable symbol name, returning false on failure.
